Bill.BriefDescription: Reaffirming and protecting the institution of marriage.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reaffirming and protecting the institution ofmarriage; amending RCW 26.04.020; creating new sections; and providingfor submission of this act to a vote of the people.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This act shall be known and cited as theWashington state defense of marriage act.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 26.04.020 and 1998 c 1 s 4 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Marriages in the following cases are prohibited: (a) When either party thereto has a wife or husband living at thetime of such marriage; (b) When the husband and wife are nearer of kin to each other thansecond cousins, whether of the whole or half blood computing by therules of the civil law; or (c) When the parties are persons other than a male and a female. (2) It is unlawful for any man to marry his father's sister,mother's sister, daughter, sister, son's daughter, daughter's daughter, p. 1 HB 2176brother's daughter or sister's daughter; it is unlawful for any womanto marry her father's brother, mother's brother, son, brother, son'sson, daughter's son, brother's son or sister's son. (3) A marriage between two persons that is recognized as valid inanother jurisdiction is valid in this state only if the marriage is notprohibited ((or made unlawful)) under subsection (1)(a)((, (1))) or (c)of this section, or unlawful under subsection (2) of this section. (4) The uniting of two persons in a nonmarital domesticrelationship, including a civil union, domestic partnership, or othersimilar relationship when the persons are other than a male and afemale is not valid in this state, and such a uniting of two personsrecognized as valid in another jurisdiction is not recognized as validin this state. (5) A person in a nonmarital domestic relationship shall notqualify for, or receive, any spousal, familial, or marital benefit,privilege, advantage, or entitlement, or any equivalent thereof, thatis paid for, directly or indirectly, in whole or in part, with publicfunds.
This act is necessary for the preservationof the public peace, health, morals, or safety, or support of the stategovernment and its existing public institutions.

The provisions of this act are to beliberally construed to effectuate the policies and purposes of thisact. In the event of conflict between this act and any other provisionof law, the provisions of this act shall govern.

If any provision of this act or itsapplication to any person or circumstance is held invalid, theremainder of the act or the application of the provision to otherpersons or circumstances is not affected.

The secretary of state shall submit this actto the people for their adoption and ratification, or rejection, at thenext general election to be held in this state, in accordance with HB 2176 p. 2 Article II, section 1 of the state Constitution and the laws adopted tofacilitate its operation.
